facts.fact: Sen. Momo Cyrus told the Senate on 3 November 2026 that Executive Order No. 163 of 22 April 2026 set up the Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation, giving it a central coordinating role in government-wide digital governance and cybersecurity.
facts.system: Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation (OTDI)

systems.system: Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation

facts.fact: Sen. Cyrus recalled that the Liberia Telecommunications Authority reported on 4 July 2025 that the National Cybersecurity Bill was under Senate committee review, with amendments and a fiscal-impact assessment under consideration; he said its current status is unknown.
